title: Rashid @ Rashid Mohammad v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Arun Bhansali, C.J. and Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as infructuous after recovery citation withdrawn.
headnote: Allahabad High Court dismissed as infructuous a writ against a recovery citation dated 24 August 2023 after the electricity department withdrew the citation on 5 February 2024. Interim orders had restrained coercive recovery while the department was to check whether the final assessment of 4 May 2022 followed the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. That question was not decided.
facts: Rashid alias Rashid Mohammad writ-petitioned the Allahabad High Court against a recovery citation dated 24 August 2023. In January 2024, counsel for the electricity department sought time to check whether a final assessment under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 had been made. He could not show a hearing date before the assessment order of 4 May 2022, or that the order was served. The Court barred coercive steps on the recovery certificate and extended that protection. The respondents withdrew the citation on 5 February 2024.

holding_units.topic: infructuous dismissal after withdrawal of recovery citation
holding_units.holding: The writ questioning the recovery citation dated 24 August 2023 was dismissed as infructuous after the electricity department withdrew that citation on 5 February 2024. The Court recorded no construction of any clause of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: Successive listings ended in dismissal as infructuous once the recovery citation was withdrawn. No clause of the Supply Code was construed.

not_decided.point: Whether the final assessment order dated 4 May 2022 followed the procedure in the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, including a fixed hearing date and service on the petitioner.
not_decided.note: The department was granted time to ascertain this. The recovery citation was withdrawn before the Court ruled.
